title: Gambit journeys
description: Players' experience of Gambit, as its README describes it to them.

entities.name: Play a friend by email
entities.description: A player invites a friend by email, and the two play over days, chatting, until the game ends and they play again.
entities.goal: Play chess with a friend who is somewhere else, at their own pace.

stages.context: Arrives at the game signed out.
stages.touchpoint: icelander.net's sign-in, with Google or GitHub
stages.action: Signs in, and is sent back to the game.
stages.outcome: The title screen, with Play a friend and Play the computer.

stages.context: Wants to play someone who has never played.
stages.action: Types the friend's address, picks a colour and sends.
stages.outcome: The invitation waits for that address; the friend is emailed if email is set up, and the player gets a link to send.

stages.context: The friend signs in with that address, from the email, the link or Friends.
stages.outcome: The game opens for them; each is now the other's contact.

stages.touchpoint: The game: the board and the transcript
stages.action: Each moves on their turn and chats; either leaves and comes back.
stages.outcome: Moves and messages appear on both screens at once; Friends shows whose move it is, and the tab's title counts what waits.

stages.context: Someone is mated, resigns, or a draw is offered and accepted.
stages.action: Reads the result in the transcript.
stages.outcome: The game is in both histories and counts in their record against each other.

stages.touchpoint: The finished game's Rematch, or the contact's Invite to a game
stages.action: Sends a new invitation, colours swapped.
stages.outcome: It waits in the friend's lobby.

entities.name: Practise against the computer
entities.description: A player plays Stockfish at a strength they choose, over one sitting or several, and keeps the game.
entities.goal: Play a game against a computer opponent of the right strength.

stages.action: Picks one of eight strengths, from Pawn Pusher to Stockfish, and a colour.
stages.outcome: The game starts; Stockfish runs in the browser.

stages.context: Makes a mistake, or is called away.
stages.action: Takes back the last move, or reloads and presses Continue later.
stages.outcome: The game carries on where it was.

stages.context: The game ends, or the player resigns.
stages.outcome: It is in the history on the server, after the server has checked it.

entities.name: Relive a past game
entities.description: A player goes back to a finished game and watches it as it was played.
entities.goal: See again how a game went, its chat included.

stages.touchpoint: History, or a contact's games together
stages.outcome: The replay, at the start position, with the whole transcript.

stages.action: Presses Play at 1×, 4× or 16×, or steps, drags the slider or clicks a move.
stages.outcome: The moves and messages come at the pace they were played, sped up, with pauses of at most three seconds.
